summary: Standardized headless Agent benchmark pipeline with immutable score-free Attempts, independently versioned Evaluations, derived Aggregate/Reward records, portable Workspaces, and trusted Clash Host evidence.
context_hints: The execution agent receives only the outcome contract and copied built-in skills; rubric checks remain outside its workspace.
Never grade from the agent final message. Resolve submission paths inside the isolated workspace, reject symlinks, hash files, and independently validate artifacts.
Recheck every installed fixture file after the agent exits; fixture mutation is a hard product-execution failure.

An agent-product case is runnable only when a real CLI or MCP surface and trusted Host readback both exist. Missing Generator or Document surfaces belong in blocked-contract cases, never raw internal HTTP instructions.
Required rubric gates fail closed even when the weighted score exceeds the pass threshold.
ProductExecution negative gates use forbiddenProductOperations; any runner-sealed CLI or MCP invocation violates the gate even when the product call domain-fails, while discovery/help is excluded.
Director v1 is structural unless real rendered media exists; MG character v1 is the geometric 2D profile, not a skeletal rig.

key_files.src/schemas.ts: Versioned benchmark, outcome, submission, and rubric schemas.
key_files.src/evaluator.ts: Director, Timeline, MG, media, artifact-set, and mixed-lineage grading.
key_files.src/runner.ts: Isolated workspace provisioning, native Agent execution, product-operation gates, trusted readback dispatch, logs, resume, and outcome generation. Director frame origin uses native Action Run plus Output Commit and exact Asset bytes, not legacy ActionAssetBinding.
key_files.src/product-readback.ts: Independent Asset, Timeline, and Remotion readback matched to submitted bytes or canonical product state.
key_files.src/fixture.ts: Fixture manifest creation, safe installation, provenance receipt, and post-Agent integrity verification.
key_files.src/environment.ts: Score-free functional/content-effect Attempt capture, runner-scaffold separation, modified Workspace capture, and OTLP receipts.
key_files.src/environment-lock.ts: Pre-execution Agent model/provider selection, exact executable evidence, Clash plugin/runtime manifest, installed skill digests, and pre/post byte verification; evaluator identity is intentionally separate.
key_files.src/benchmark-task.ts: Canonical immutable Task evidence shared by functional and content-effect attempts.
key_files.src/atif.ts: Codex exec-event and Pi agent-event to ATIF-v1.7 structured projection with reasoning omission and recursive privacy redaction.
key_files.src/attempt-manifest.ts: Immutable score-free Attempt inventory binding Task, Agent Environment, Workspace trees, trajectories, readback, logs, and facts-only OTLP under attemptDigest.
key_files.src/evaluation-records.ts: Immutable content-addressed Evaluation, Aggregate, and Reward contracts bound to one Attempt digest.
key_files.src/evaluation-pipeline.ts: Compatibility adapter that maps current technical and quality reports into independent versioned Evaluation records and a selected Aggregate.
key_files.src/result-bundle.ts: Replaceable current index referencing one immutable Attempt plus zero or more Evaluations and optional Aggregate/Reward records.
key_files.src/otel.ts: Score-free OTLP/JSON Attempt trace from normalized Agent actions, sealed runner CLI evidence, and fingerprinted trusted Host readback.
key_files.src/cli.ts: CLI entry point for real Codex, Claude Code, and Pi benchmark runs with explicit ready-Environment model/provider selection; command agents remain portable-only.
key_files.src/claude-adapter.test.ts: Claude print-mode arguments, Project Host readiness before stdio MCP binding, skills, stream-json trajectory, and error contracts.
key_files.src/index.test.ts: Artifact security, hard-gate, mixed-source, suite, and real child-process runner contracts.
key_files.src/task-skill-pack.ts: Resolve a named task pack into the exact per-Task skill set before installation and Environment content locking.
key_files.src/codex-task-skills.ts: Provide only mounted skill metadata through Codex native developer instructions; automatic global skill instructions are disabled without modifying user configuration.
